diagnostics.message: The EKS node group should wait for the worker-node IAM policy attachment. The aws_eks_node_group provider documentation warns that its role permissions must exist before node-group handling (and remain until deletion completes); the current node group only references the role, not this attachment.

The EKS node group should wait for the additional IAM policy attachments on its role so those permissions are present before node-group provisioning and are retained through node-group deletion. No attribute from this attachment resource can be cleanly wired into the node group's configuration, so an explicit dependency is appropriate.
